capabilities: Draw freehand strokes directly on .canvas files
Configure brush color, size, opacity, and hardness
Select, move, resize, recolor, restyle, and delete strokes
Smooth handwriting-style strokes with pressure-aware tapering
Store drawings inside the canvas file under drawInCanvas
extras: Drawings are only visible when the plugin is enabled; very dense drawings can affect performance.
intentEvidence: Draw in Canvas adds a lightweight drawing layer to .canvas files while keeping the normal JSON Canvas data intact.
problem: Obsidian Canvas has no built-in way to draw, sketch, or handwrite on a canvas board.

relations.evidence: perfect-freehand for the handwritten stroke algorithm.
Obsidian Canvas and JSON Canvas for the canvas format this plugin extends.

summary: Drawing layer for Obsidian Canvas that adds freehand strokes, stored inside the .canvas file, with brush controls and post-draw editing.
